normalization.punctuation: replace every character outside A-Z and 0-9 with a space
normalization.corporateTokens: remove whole tokens PT and TBK
normalization.matching: exact normalized full company name; do not use substring, corporate affiliation, or bank-to-subsidiary matching

BQ.name: PT Korea Investment and Sekuritas Indonesia

MU.name: PT Minna Padi Investama Sekuritas Tbk

notes: OJK August 2026 shortens the current name to PT Kay Hian; KSEI publishes PT Kay Hian Sekuritas. The full KSEI name is used and both grounded forms are aliases.
